obligation_note: Honestly scored. No legal or functional compulsion exists for the individual buyer. Urgency is manufactured from the buyer's comp calendar rather than the category.

primary_roi_driver.dollar_roi_calculation: ICP median base $145,000. Conservative 9% uplift on one successful comp event = $13,050 year one. Compounding off the new base = $71,000+ over 5 years. Product price $697. Year-one return 18.7x. Buyer breaks even at a 0.48% raise.

value_equation_elements.dream_outcome: A $12,000-$40,000 comp increase inside one review cycle without being labelled difficult
value_equation_elements.perceived_likelihood_mechanism: The Warmth Anchor Sequence: third-party anchor, scope ledger, warmth frame, silence hold, written follow. Each step maps to a documented failure mode in the negotiation-backlash literature rather than to a motivational idea.
value_equation_elements.time_to_first_value: Under 20 minutes. The Ask Tax Audit returns a personalised annual dollar figure at checkout.
value_equation_elements.effort_reduction_method: Scripts, templates and a calculator. Fill-in-the-blank. No curriculum, no modules, no mindset work.
